initial_checkpoint: The episode-start estimator is trusted/authenticated. No new anchors occur during the scored window; recovery propagates this potentially stale anchor open-loop.
monitor_track: Consumes all received payloads and actual postcommit randomized centers; it supplies the prediction feedback that generates trusted event bits.
production_track: Uses monitor posterior before alarm; after alarm hard rollback predicts open loop from the episode-start trusted checkpoint. Soft policy uses fixed alpha=0.5 convex blend of monitor posterior and checkpoint prediction after alarm.
metrics: hard rollback to episode-start checkpoint cumulative paired MSE excess
soft fusion cumulative paired MSE excess
absolute healthy MSE of each recovery policy
not_claimed: recovery of target-time damage before audit
continuous MSE theorem for recovery track
independent time samples within an episode
